content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Shreveport

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your background—secondary degree holders and bachelor's degree holders face different thresholds. Gather your project documentation now to streamline your application later.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend synchronous sessions on your schedule—no travel required, no fixed classroom location. Our active certified practitioners cover the PMBOK® Guide framework, real-world case studies, and exam strategies across the full curriculum.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your 35-hour course, submit your formal application directly to PMI with your verified experience hours and education records. Pay PMI's examination fee at submission. Plan ahead: PMI's review process takes time, so submit as soon as your training is complete.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours—to strengthen your readiness. The PMP exam is administered year-round at testing centers. Schedule your exam date and take the test when you feel confident in your mastery of the material.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Your PMP credential is valid for three years. During your renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved training, volunteer work, and professional contributions. PMI's portfolio system tracks your PDUs; renew before expiration to keep your credential active and your career advancement on track.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
